questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: The nurse was kind, ______ she helped the old man.
questions.explanation: 前半句是原因，后半句是结果，用 so 连接。
questions.evidence: The clinic was busy, so the nurses had little time to explain.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: I drink water ______ I want to be healthy.
questions.explanation: 后半句是原因，用 because 引出。
questions.evidence: Sleep is important because your body needs rest.

questions.explanation: should 后面接动词原形，不加 to，也不用 -ing。
questions.evidence: Go to bed at the same time every night.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct comparative form: This sheet is ______ than a long talk.
questions.explanation: good 的比较级是不规则变化 better。
questions.evidence: This sheet is better than a long talk.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct superlative form: It will be the ______ sheet in the city.
questions.explanation: 三者以上比较用最高级，short 的最高级是 shortest。
questions.evidence: It will be the shortest sheet in the city.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct comparative form: Walking is ______ than running for old people.
questions.explanation: easy 变比较级时，把 y 变成 i 再加 -er，即 easier。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: You ______ go to bed early. It is good for you.
questions.evidence: Go to bed at the same time every night.

options: Because the clinic was busy, so the nurses were tired.
The clinic was busy, so the nurses were tired.
The clinic was busy, because so the nurses were tired.
answers: The clinic was busy, so the nurses were tired.
questions.explanation: because 和 so 不能同时出现在一个句子里，因此只有第二句正确。
questions.evidence: The clinic was busy, so the nurses had little time to explain.

title: A Clearer Clinic Visit · 规则与新语境练习
instructions: 先阅读本组中文规则与原句，区分新结构和已学规则，再完成独立句子；同一材料再次出现属于巩固，保持原ID。
passage:
在英语中，表示原因和结果可以用 because 和 so。because 引出原因，so 引出结果。例如：The clinic was busy, so the nurses had little time to explain.（诊所很忙，所以护士们很少有时间解释。）这里 so 后面是结果。注意：because 和 so 不能同时用在一个句子里。should 用来提建议，意思是“应该”，后面接动词原形。例如：You should sleep eight hours.（你应该睡八个小时。）比较级用于两者比较，最高级用于三者或以上比较。规则变化：一般加 -er / -est；以 e 结尾加 -r / -st；重读闭音节双写末尾字母再加 -er / -est；辅音字母+y 结尾变 y 为 i 再加 -er / -est；多音节词前加 more / most。例如：short → shorter → shortest；easy → easier → easiest；important → more important → most important。

The clinic was busy, so the nurses had little time to explain.
